newsitem.title: USA: UGI, NORSTAR end talks for Norstar Energy.
newsitem.headline: UGI, NORSTAR end talks for Norstar Energy.

text.p: UGI Energy Services Inc said Tuesday that it and NORSTAR Management Inc have ended their talks over UGI's proposed acquisition of certain assets of NORSTAR Energy LP.

UGI Energy, which is doing business as GASMARK, said it and NORSTAR were unable to agree on terms of a definitive purchase agreement. The companies announced last month that they had entered a letter of intent for the deal.

"We are disappointed that we failed to reach an agreement with NORSTAR, but GASMARK will continue to look for growth opportunities in the northeastern United States," GASMARK said in a statement Tuesday.
NORSTAR Management and NORSTAR Energy are indirect subsidiaries of Orange and Rockland Utilities Inc.

UGI Energy is a subsidiary of UGI Corp's UGI Enterprises, has revenues of more than $100 million. UGI Corp's other businesses include UGI Utilities Inc, a Pennsylvania gas and electric utility, and AmeriGas Propane Inc, general partner of AmeriGas Partners LP, the nation's largest retail propane marketer.
